landing_point.why: The advisory summary names XSLTransformer.php _transformPHP, and the XML DOM setup with resolveExternals is at lines 300-302.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The External path only re-parses the output of an admin-configured shell XSLT command (XSLTransformer.php:70-82, 240-251), not the attacker's document, and the advisory names only _transformPHP, so a solver can argue it is trusted, non-default output.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Named entities declared in a DTD (the code comment cites  ) must still expand. Local XSL stylesheets loaded by file name must still load. An over-broad fix (rejecting any DOCTYPE, or dropping entity substitution) breaks entity expansion, which the comment documents as required.

O6_input_shapes: external-processor result string re-parsed to DOM

O8_uncovered_routes.route: XMLTypeDescription::checkType parses a string input and, for the 'dtd' validation strategy, calls DOMDocument::validate(), which can fetch the external DTD named in the document's DOCTYPE; the fix did not touch it
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: This is type validation in a neighbouring class, not the transformer, and no in-repo filter config uses an xml::dtd(...) type, so a solver could call it unused.

O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Import XML often carries HTML named entities, and XSLTransformer.php:295-302 shows the maintainers already enabled entity resolution for that reason.

O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: User import uploads come from managers and are parsed in a separate plugin package, far from classes/xslt.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Plugin gallery feed parsed with recover/substituteEntities to tolerate malformed remote XML
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It is remote, network-fetched XML. Tolerant parsing flags are a common maintainer choice there, and it lives in another package.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Remove resolveExternals/substituteEntities (or add LIBXML_NONET) only on the _transformPHP XML-string load and miss the file/XSL loads and the _transformExternal result re-parse.

out_of_scope_notes: XSLTransformer.php:348-349 registerPHPFunctions on the XSLTProcessor is a separate code-execution concern, not pursued.
XSLTransformer.php:232-240 builds an exec() command from config and parameters; that is command construction, not pursued.
PKPContainer.php:682 sets a global libxml streams context (proxy) that affects every libxml network fetch; noted only.
unverified: The published fix passes LIBXML_NONET | LIBXML_NOENT (fix.diff:18,33,38,47,52). LIBXML_NOENT keeps entity substitution on, and on libxml2 >= 2.9 it re-enables external entity loading. NONET blocks only network fetches, so file:// external entities may still resolve after the published fix. Not run. If this holds, hidden tests modelled on the published fix cannot assert local-file XXE is blocked, and a solver's stricter fix could diverge from upstream.
That DOMDocument::validate() at classes/xslt/XMLTypeDescription.php:134 fetches an external DTD subset after a plain loadXML is libxml behaviour I believe but did not run.

Other DOM parses (NativeImportFilter.php:40, XMLTypeDescription.php:125, PluginGalleryDAO.php:131) use default options and are believed safe on libxml2 >= 2.9; PKPXMLParser.php:216 (expat xml_parser) registers no external entity handler. Not run.

There is no in-repo caller of XSLTransformationFilter or XSLTransformer beyond InstallForm::checkSupport (classes/install/form/InstallForm.php:118); HTTP entry points live in the host apps (OJS/OMP/OPS), which were outside the allowed repositories.
